message.reasoning: The user wants to identify which colored dot is on the handle of the wrench. Looking at the image, there is a gray wrench in the center. It has three dots on it: yellow at the top (the open jaw/head), green at the pivot area (head), and blue on the long lower part which is the handle. The purple dot is on the orange dropper object to the right. So the handle is marked by the blue dot. The options: A Green, B Yellow, C Purple, D Blue. The correct answer is D.
